findings.note: Accurate and complete as written: the command is Args=cobra.NoArgs with zero flags and returns a bare name array, so there are no parameters or filters a longer Short could name. Also a DO-NOT-EDIT generated file (platform_client.go carries the generator header); already carries mcp:read-only=true.

Genuinely under-sells the command -- it exposes eight filters (--query, --source, --resource, --action, --min-confidence, --limit, --db, --warnings) that the Short never mentions, so an agent cannot tell from the catalog that filtering is supported. Not fixable here: teach.go is a DO-NOT-EDIT generated file, so this needs a generator-template fix (retro candidate), not a hand-edit that the next regen wipes.
